subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should Control UI hard refreshes and bookmarks on legacy or arbitrary non-tab route prefixes be supported for public assets, or should support stay limited to root, known app routes, configured basePath, and `/__openclaw__/`?
rationale: Source shows remaining prefixed public-asset 404 behavior, but changing it defines a URL/static-routing contract and affects gateway static-file safety, so automation should not choose that policy alone.

options.title: Support narrow prefixed public assets
options.body: Land a tightly allowlisted fix for known Control UI public assets on supported deep or legacy routes while preserving 404s for unknown static files.

options.title: Document limited URL support
options.body: Declare arbitrary or legacy non-tab prefixes unsupported, point users to root or configured basePath URLs, and close the issue plus stale linked PRs with that rationale.

options.title: Replace the fork PR
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PR and request a fresh narrow PR only after maintainers choose the supported URL contract.

recommendation.title: Support narrow prefixed public assets
recommendation.body: Land a tightly allowlisted fix for known Control UI public assets on supported deep or legacy routes while preserving 404s for unknown static files.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing candidate from adjacent gateway public-asset work and related issue proof.
